Migration.Method: Runtime, dependencies, constraints, tooling, observability, and testing policy were retained as explicit technology context.

Runtime.Framework: Flutter 3.x with Dart 3 syntax and AOT Android builds.
Runtime.Application: Flutter app using flutter_bloc Cubit state management, provider UI composition, and get_it service location.
Runtime.NativeBoundary: Android Automotive APIs are accessed through the path package android_automotive_plugin.

Dependencies.Dependency-get_it: ^8.0.3; service locator, registered independently per isolate.
Dependencies.Dependency-shared_preferences: ^2.5.2; settings, presets, modes, and theme persistence.
Dependencies.Dependency-flutter_background_service: ^5.0.5; foreground service while the app is backgrounded.
Dependencies.Dependency-android_automotive_plugin: path:packages/android_automotive_plugin; local HVAC, sensor, and ignition bridge.
Dependencies.DevDependency-mocktail: ^1.0.5; mock interactions for service and native boundaries.

VersionConstraints.AndroidMinSdk: 23; Android Automotive compatibility range documented by the legacy plan.
VersionConstraints.Plugin: 0.x local path package with no independent published version.

Observability.Logger: Logger plus LogRingBuffer support structured fields, test sinks, redaction, and debug UI inspection.
Observability.NativeBoundary: Plugin code does not import the app Logger; HvacService and runtime modules provide application-level markers.
